Subject: Bay 6 freight window & crate weight caps — need confirmation

Hi team and BlueShip,

We're finalizing the crate routing plan for CloudCon (Bay 6 arrival). Production just sent the manifest and a few crates are heavy — one listed at 1,600 lbs and two at ~1,350 lbs. Our original dock booking (Bay 6) has a tailgate slot on 04/28 but I haven't confirmed liftgate/forklift availability there.

Questions:
- Can BlueShip accept single-crate lifts above 1,200 lbs at Bay 6, or will we need to split onto smaller skids?
- Moscone logistics — is Bay 6 lift-equipped or should we plan to stage at Bay 4 for offload? Any per-crate weight caps we need to follow?
- If we must split, what's the latest production cutoff to break crates and re-label without delaying the build?

I'm attaching the weight_manifest.xlsx for reference. Stephanie — can you confirm the signage sequence so crates are labeled for staging order? Marcus — once we know lift availability, can you coordinate rental/forklift with EventPower?

We need a firm plan by EOD 04/27 to keep the shipping schedule.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Event Ops
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bay 6 freight window & crate weight caps — need confirmation

Marissa / team,

Thanks for the manifest — we reviewed the weights. A couple notes:
- Our standard tailgate/liftgate can safely handle up to ~1,200 lbs per lift. Anything above that requires either a tail-lift truck with higher capacity (limited availability) or split into multiple pallets/skids for two-person lift with a forklift on site.
- We can provision a heavy-lift truck and dedicated crew, but it would add a surcharge and is subject to availability for your requested window.

Available pickup options from our side:
- 04/28 08:00–10:00 (earlier slot on your booked day) — standard tailgate only (limit 1,200 lbs per object)
- 04/29 06:00–08:00 — heavy-lift truck option (can handle up to 2,500 lbs single crate) for an additional fee

If you confirm the 04/29 heavy-lift slot, we will require photos of the crate base and exact dimensions, and Moscone's approval for on-site lift. If you prefer splitting, please upload a revised manifest with new palletization by 04/27 17:00 PT.

– Mateo, Ops Manager
BlueShip Logistics

From: Moscone Center Logistics <docks@moscone.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, BlueShip Logistics <ops@blueshiplogistics.com>
Cc: quotes@eventpower.com, logan.wright@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bay 6 freight window & crate weight caps — need confirmation

Hi Marissa / BlueShip,

Confirming on-venue limits for the Moscone loading docks:
- Bay 6: max single-piece crate weight = 1,200 lbs. No forklift access from Bay 6 ramp — only tail-lift unloads.
- Bay 4 (adjacent): has dock-level forklifts available and can handle single pieces up to 2,500 lbs, but Bay 4 is a shared staging lane and requires a 45-minute rolling window to secure a forklift.
- Maximum gross vehicle axle weight on site is 18,000 lbs — coordinate truck manifests accordingly.

If you plan to use Bay 4 for heavier crates, we require the truck ETA and a venue access form completed for forklift staging (attached). Also attaching the moscone_bay_specs.pdf showing dock dimensions and clearance.

Regards,
Lance Herrera
Facilities Coordinator
Moscone Center Logistics

Attachment: moscone_bay_specs.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Bay 6 freight window & crate weight caps — need confirmation

Thanks Mateo and Lance — helpful details. Plan below:

1) We will split the three heavy crates into smaller skids so no single piece exceeds 1,200 lbs for Bay 6 tailgate unload. Production has 24 hours to repalletize and will deliver an updated manifest by 04/27 17:00 PT.
2) Logan — please reserve the 04/28 08:00–10:00 tailgate slot with BlueShip for the first wave (lighter crates). We'll use Bay 4 for the oversize pieces only if production cannot finish repalletizing by cutoff; in that case we will switch to the 04/29 heavy-lift slot.
3) Marcus — please coordinate a short-term forklift + operator through EventPower for a 45-minute window in Bay 4 (standby) and confirm costs. Stephanie — update crate labeling and the signage sequence: "Demo Kits (Wave 1)" then "Heavy Staging (Bay 4)" so the build crew knows where to pull each crate.

I've uploaded a revised banner_specs_v3.pdf — this contains the final dimensions and mounting notes so production can avoid overhang issues when creating pallets. Also uploading the signed venue access doc to DocuSign (see drive link).

If we get the manifest by 17:00 today I'll finalize the routing and share the truck ETAs.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Event Ops
Redwood Inference
